kurz: Heavy pans store a lot of heat and barely cool down when food goes in. Light ones react quickly but lose heat quickly.
bild_im_kopf: Like a big battery versus a small one.
was_passiert: Cast iron and thick iron pans store a lot of heat and are ideal for searing. Stainless steel with a sandwich base spreads heat evenly. Non-stick pans forgive sticky foods but cannot take very high heat.
faustregeln: Searing: cast iron or carbon steel.
Eggs and fish: non-stick or well-preheated stainless steel.

params.links: thin and light: reacts fast, cools a lot
params.rechts: heavy, cast iron: stores heat, ideal for searing
